content:
maria (devex): Starting RC-2 publish for python+ts SDK. Change window 09:00-10:00 PT. Please hold new PRs to release branch. I'll kick off canary after CI green. tagging kevin for pin plan. :rocket:
deploy-bot: publish_job #874 started for job sdk-publish-rc2 (node=pub-08)
sam (qa): CI looks failing on packaging step — npm pack error, seeing intermittent tarball checksum mismatch. cc @maria
kevin (releases): hold canary. don't pin new major yet. if packaging flakes we should delay and republish a fixed artifact.
maria (devex): good call. aborting canary. noah can you check registry replication? also sharing quick debug steps:
noah (infra): digging in — registry upload is returning 502 from edge for a subset of objects. looks like S3 multipart finalization timeout. I'm re-running the upload from the runner:
```
make publish-py VERSION=0.18.0-rc.2
python -m twine upload dist/* --verbose
```
sam (qa): re-run of upload failed once but passed on 2nd attempt. still seeing flaky checksum across runners. likely CI container cache causing bad tar.
kevin (releases): plan B: staggered publish. publish TS canary first to npm with `-rc.2`, then python after we confirm artifacts. Pin policy: keep previous stable pinned as `0.18.0` in internal docs and do not auto-upgrade customers on RC.
maria (devex): I'll update release notes draft and add deprecation note for legacy sync client in CHANGELOG. Julie please sync with docs on API surface changes.
julie (pm): on it. I'll add a short paragraph and call out migration steps. timeline shift: new change window 13:00-14:00 PT if infra needs hotfix.
deploy-bot: job sdk-publish-rc2 aborted by maria (devex)
maria (devex): Decision: abort. Action items: 
- noah: investigate registry timeouts + retry logic (owner)
- sam: re-run full integration after fix (owner)
- kevin: prepare pinning/protect rule and communicate to SRE (owner)
- julie: update release notes and docs stub (owner)
I'll post a follow-up when we have green signal to resume canary. :white_check_mark:
kevin (releases): also creating a short rollback playbook in case we accidentally publish broken wheel. snippet for pin revert:
```
# revert internal pin
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" "https://internal-registry/repo/pins/0.18.0" -d '{"pin": "0.17.3"}'
```
sam (qa): ack, standing by. add `--no-cache` to the pip build step when re-testing.
maria (devex): thanks team. will reschedule canary announce in #devex when ready. :pray:
